svg.title: Property map across CI platforms
svg.desc: 40 documented properties by 3 CI platforms, as the CI evidence collector checks them. In 115 cells every mapped test must run and pass exactly once; in 5 Windows cells the declared Unix-only tests are exempt and the rest are required. This is the rule, not the result of a particular run.

g.text: each cell: every mapped test must run
and pass exactly once on that platform,
or CI evidence is not COMPLETE
one cube per property, P01 to P40
the rule, not one run: read each run's
